# .github/workflows/audit-sample.yml

name: Audit Data Sample

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      samples:
        description: 'Number of samples per type'
        required: false
        default: '20'
      types:
        description: 'Types to audit (comma-separated: player,score,box)'
        required: false
        default: 'player,score,box'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Run audit
        run: node scripts/audit-sample.js --samples=${{ inputs.samples }} --types=${{ inputs.types }}

      - name: Upload report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: audit-report
          path: audit-report-*.json
          retention-days: 30
